title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Announces Ultra-Limited $429 Life-Size Arm of Gustave Replica
text:
Sandfall Interactive and Purearts unveil the Arm of Gustave, a life-size, highly detailed replica of the iconic mechanical arm from the 2025 Game of the Year winner Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Priced at $429, this premium polyresin collectible features rotating cylinders and a floral rock base, with each piece numbered. Pre-orders are open for the Q3 2027 release, targeting hardcore fans and collectors.
The highly acclaimed game Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, which won numerous awards including Game of the Year in 2025, continues to captivate its dedicated fanbase with new content and merchandise.
Developer Sandfall Interactive has actively supported the title since its release, offering updates, seasonal events, and a variety of collectibles. Among the most ambitious releases is a new life-size replica: the Arm of Gustave. This meticulously crafted piece, produced by Purearts, is a premium polyresin recreation of the iconic mechanical arm from the game, finished with marble texture and gold accents.
It stands 19 inches tall and features rotating combination cylinders, exactly as seen in the title, mounted on a rocky base adorned with sculpted flowers. The item is a direct tribute to a pivotal, emotionally resonant moment in protagonist Maelle's story. Priced at $429, the Arm of Gustave is clearly aimed at the most devoted collectors and fans, positioning it as one of the most expensive pieces of video game merchandise to date.
Each replica includes a unique numbered plate, emphasizing its limited availability. pre-orders are now open on the Purearts website, with shipping scheduled for the third quarter of 2027, marking a celebration of the game's one-year anniversary. While this is not the sequel many anticipated, it reflects a growing trend of developers offering high-end, immersive memorabilia, similar to CD Projekt Red's Cyberpunk 2077 replica katanas.
Fans await further announcements, but for now, the Arm of Gustave stands as a monumental testament to the game's impact and narrative significance
